tests.evidence: verify_bundle_paths verified the live 48-row bundle and all declared hashes.

Injecting v2.STRICT_PID_TEXT into a bound row's match_semantics was rejected with ValueError: Effective review policy mismatch at row 1. v3 validate_queue_rows additionally rejects a remaining strict sentence (wrapper lines 328-329).

Supplying the v1 source queue with the v3 manifest was rejected with ValueError: Manifest score_root mismatch. The verifier binds manifest queue/template paths, source provenance, row identity/order, and run/Gold paths (lines 438-567).

A copied manifest with queue_sha256 set to 64 zeroes was rejected with ValueError: Manifest queue SHA-256 mismatch. The live verifier recomputes every declared path/hash binding and frozen source path/hash.

Changing one synthetic second-review Gold-item score produced IncompleteFinalization: adopted=47/48, conflicts=1. build_finalization raises before publish when conflicts exist, adopted count is short, or queue length differs (lines 1011-1015).

Publishing a complete synthetic result into a pre-created target was rejected with FileExistsError; its sentinel remained the sole child. atomic_publish_directory creates privately and publishes only by rename (lines 162-182).

A synthetic step with subject, operation, object, and command_line emitted exactly subject/operation/object slots; command_line was not a slot. Live queue kinds were exactly object, operation, subject. Base candidate_slots lines 339-377 and v3 policy require action=operation.

Setting alert_mapping_scored=true in a bound row was rejected with ValueError: Effective review policy mismatch at row 1. The verifier also requires manifest hidden_alert_mapping_scored=false (lines 583-594).

Static import/call scan found only argparse, json, os, shutil, sys, tempfile, uuid, pathlib, datetime, collections, typing, and local scorers; no requests/urllib/http/socket/API client or subprocess network invocation. All executed tests were local Python only.

atomic_publish_directory successfully created and base.filesystem_path read a result.json at full path length 298. This score root is length 229 and its normal artifact filenames reach 279; v3 uses the base extended-path adapter for filesystem I/O. Raw pathlib exists may be false at these lengths, but the scored verifier passed against the live bundle.

commands_and_reproductions: Local temporary Python harness: alternate v1 queue; strict-PID and hidden-alert policy mutations; manifest queue-hash mutation; 47/48 conflict; create-only collision sentinel; 298-character extended-path publish/read; all temporary files removed with Windows extended-path cleanup.
Python AST import enumeration of the v3 wrapper.
conclusion: No requested anti-pattern was accepted by the independently reproduced tests. The native pathlib long-path observation is environmental only; all scorer filesystem operations exercised here use the extended-path adapter and passed.
